name: LRO LOLA Polar Gridded Digital Elevation Model (GDR)
source: NASA Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter / LOLA Science Team / PDS Geosciences Node
crs: IAU Moon 2000 / Lunar Polar Stereographic (EPSG:75400, Center: 90°S, 0°E)
resolution: 20 meters/pixel (interpolated to 5m in critical landing zones)
acquisition_info: Multi-year laser altimeter profiling from 50km circular polar orbit (2009-2023). Over 6.5 billion individual laser altimetry points.
citation: Smith, D. E., et al. (2010), Initial observations from the Lunar Orbiter Laser Altimeter (LOLA) on the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter. GRL 37, L18204.
notes: Used as the baseline geodetic and topographical reference for all South Pole elevation and macro-slope calculations.

name: LROC WAC Lunar South Pole Illumination Mosaic
source: NASA Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter Camera (LROC) / Arizona State University
data_type: Optical Visible Albedo & Multi-Temporal Illumination Fractions
crs: Lunar Polar Stereographic (Sphere R=1737.4 km, Lat_0=-90, Lon_0=0)
acquisition_info: Synthesized from 6-month continuous coverage during southern summer (October 2009 to February 2010, ~1200 orbits).
citation: Speyerer, E. J., & Robinson, M. S. (2013). Persistently illuminated regions at the lunar poles: Ideal sites for future exploration. Icarus, 222(1), 122-136.
notes: Provides empirical benchmark percentages for cumulative solar visibility at candidate landing sites.

name: LROC NAC Controlled Polar Orthomosaics
source: NASA / Arizona State University / USGS Astrogeology Science Center
acquisition_info: Narrow Angle Camera targeted stereo pairs and repeated low-sun lighting tracks across candidate Artemis zones.
citation: Robinson, M. S., et al. (2010). Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter Camera (LROC) Instrument Overview. Space Science Reviews, 150(1-4), 81-124.
notes: Primary imagery layer for crater identification and high-resolution visual context in the Lunar Navigator.

name: Diviner Lunar Radiometer Polar Temperature & Volatiles Stability Model
data_type: Thermal Infrared Brightness Temperature / Modelled Ice Deposition
acquisition_info: Continuous 9-channel thermal infrared radiometric observations spanning full lunar diurnal cycles over 14 years.
citation: Paige, D. A., et al. (2010). Diviner Lunar Radiometer Observations of Cold Traps in the Moon's South Polar Region. Science, 330(6003), 479-482.
notes: Used to cross-reference permanently shadowed regions (PSRs) where temperatures stay strictly below 110K.

name: High-Fidelity Synthetic Micro-Roughness & Boulder Field Generator
acquisition_info: Generated via fractional Brownian motion (fBm) parameterized by LOLA Hurst exponents (H=0.78) and Apollo/Surveyor rock size-frequency distributions.
citation: Demonstration scientific simulation model. Based on Shoemaker et al. (1969) power-law boulder frequency equations.
notes: Provides high-frequency hazard and landing-gear clearance evaluations where raw 0.5m NAC stereo DEMs are computationally unavailable in hackathon environment.

name: SPICE-Derived South Pole Solar Azimuth & Elevation Simulator
source: LUNA NAV Astrodynamics Model (JPL DE421 Ephemeris Approximation)
data_type: Time-Series Solar Vector & Earth Line-of-Sight Telemetry
acquisition_info: Calculated using lunar obliquity (1.5424° to ecliptic) and lunar precession cycle (18.6 years) for 2026-2027 mission window.
citation: Derived from NASA NAIF SPICE kernel algorithms for lunar south polar horizon shading.
notes: Provides dynamic temporal solar availability curves for candidate sites across the simulated mission timeline.
